failed_acs_addressed.fix_description: Merged-suite gate regression (merge-index #15 npm test -- --run, #26 make test-frontend): the frozen-titled ac4 test 'an unhandled request fails loudly through the error onUnhandledRequest harness' leaked msw 2.3.5's error-strategy InternalError ('[MSW] Cannot bypass a request...') as a process-level orphan unhandledRejection after the test completed; vitest 1.6 default reporter counts it as a run error and exits 1 despite 52/52 passing. Fixed inside the test body only: the test now temporarily removes the incumbent process 'unhandledRejection' listeners (vitest's run-level counter), installs its own consume listener, awaits a macrotask (setTimeout 50ms) so the msw rejection lands while the test is still active, asserts the loud-failure InternalError is among the consumed reasons, and restores every borrowed listener in a finally block. The test still proves loud failure (rejects with a non-empty normalized ApiError) and asserts strictly more than before; frozen title unchanged; setup.ts onUnhandledRequest:'error' untouched.

FAILURE ANALYSIS: verifier run f9262252, failure_type=implementation, MERGED_SUITE_GATE_REGRESSION. All 5 pinned ACs rc=0 but merge-index #15 (t9 'npm test -- --run') and #26 (t4 'make test-frontend') exit 1 deterministically under the DEFAULT vitest reporter. Root cause confirmed by code read + probe: msw 2.3.5 SetupServerCommonApi registers an 'unhandledException' interceptor listener that rethrows InternalError; @mswjs/interceptors awaits listeners via emitAsync inside an until() wrapper, so the throw both surfaces as the XHR error (axios rejects -> normalized ApiError, caught by the test) AND escapes as an orphan rejected promise that nothing can attach a handler to synchronously. Vitest 1.6 registers a PROCESS-LEVEL unhandledRejection listener (vendor/cli-api catchError -> 'Unhandled Rejection' run error; the default reporter then exits 1); the --reporter=json leg of pinned ac5 does not count it, which is why ac5 masked the defect.

RED REPRODUCED FIRST (pre-fix, at 53644f9): contract-only default reporter rc=1 ('Vitest caught 1 unhandled error... Tests 4 passed, Errors 1 error'); full-suite default reporter rc=1 (verified by git-stashing the fix, running 'npx.cmd vitest run' -> rc=1, then stash pop; git status confirmed only the one test file modified throughout). Matches verifier isolation evidence exactly.

FIX MECHANISM (test-code only, single file frontend/src/test/handlers_contract.test.ts, +52/-5): inside the failing test body, before issuing the unhandled request, the test snapshots the current process 'unhandledRejection' listeners (vitest's run-level counter among them), removes them, and installs a local consume listener. It then performs the same api.get('/api/v1/nonexistent-endpoint') in try/catch (still asserting rejection with a non-empty normalized ApiError message), awaits one macrotask (setTimeout 50ms) so the orphaned msw rejection fires while the test is still ACTIVE and is captured by the consume listener, and in a finally block removes the consume listener and re-adds every borrowed listener (exact restore, no leak across tests). After the finally, it asserts that a consumed reason is an Error whose message includes 'Cannot bypass a request when using the "error" strategy' - i.e. the test now POSITIVELY asserts the harness's loud failure at both layers (api rejection + MSW error-strategy rejection). Not a no-op, not weakened, no try/catch-and-ignore, process guard is scoped to this test's dynamic extent only.

WHY NOT THE ALTERNATIVES: (a) server.events.on('unhandledRequest') alone cannot prevent the escape - the InternalError is thrown by msw's own unhandledException interceptor listener independently of the emitter event; (b) msw's 'unhandledException' emitter event cannot be subscribed from test code without reaching into private interceptor internals (server.interceptor) and even then the async-listener rejection race remains; (c) touching setup.ts (shared t9 harness, frozen) or package.json/vitest config was forbidden scope. The process-listener borrow/restore is the minimal fix fully contained in the permitted file.
